name: PayRequest

evidence.links: F16: hosted payment links and pages with QR codes, shared by email or SMS, no website needed
evidence.billing: F14: Business plan subscriptions with stored card or SEPA mandate; F15: retries and portal
evidence.crypto: C01: native USDC checkout on Base and Solana; C02: seller's own wallet, no custody

line: Payment links, invoices and subscriptions through connected providers.

cells.countries: Follows connected-provider markets; no full allowlist
cells.payout: Connected provider pays out; no universal schedule

fee.plan: Free plan; €25 cap on PayRequest fee
fee.math: The Free plan adds 2% per successful payment, capped at €25. Payment processing fees from Stripe, Mollie or PayPal vary by country.
